settings.title: Four disciplines that work better together

settings.editor: Most projects use two or three. All of them start with a paid first week, so that both sides can change their minds cheaply.
Strategy, naming, identity and the guidelines to keep them alive after we leave.
Websites and products, designed and built by one team that sits at one table.
Launches, films and the unglamorous assets a campaign actually runs on.
Identity in movement: titles, product films, social loops, sound.
A paid week of questions, interviews and a first point of view. You can stop here.
Two or three routes, shown on real things. We choose one together.
Weekly reviews, a shared board, no surprises. Design and build run side by side.
We are there on the day and for a month after. Then we hand over the keys.

settings.title: Got a brief? Or only half of one?

settings.editor: Either is a fine place to start. Tell us what you are trying to do and when; we answer within a day, with questions.
